scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: How Calibration Content Shapes Attention-Based Reranking
papers.authors: Petros Karypis, Hossein Rajaby Faghihi, Peter Chen, Rui Zhu, Noveen Sachdeva, Yan Zhu, Julian McAuley
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.17764v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Attention-based rerankers score documents by aggregating query-to-document attention and subtracting a null-query calibration pass to remove positional and structural bias. Although widely used, this calibration assumes that the null pass removes irrelevant signal from each document. We show that modern prompt content, e.g. constraints, instructions, personas, and demonstrations can violate this assumption when it enters the scoring readout, making the null pass relevance-aware rather than null. We find that calibration is especially harmful when applied to prompts containing longer, more detailed instructions as the null-pass step removes relevant signal. Based on these findings, we propose interpolated null calibration, a training-free modification that controls how much of the instruction content enters the null baseline. It recovers attention-based reranking performance on instruction-heavy tasks where standard calibration fails, w
papers.summary: 注意力重排通常用空查询分数扣除位置偏差，但含详细指令的空查询也携带相关性信号，直接相减会损伤排序。论文提出在含指令与无指令的空查询之间插值，无需训练即可修复这一问题；Gemma-3-4B 在 InstructIR 的 nDCG@10 从标准校准的 0.275 升至 0.825，适合检查社区搜索复杂需求的重排链路。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 搜索若把用户约束、角色或偏好写入重排提示，应同时检查这些信息是否被校准步骤抵消。可在带否定约束和详细需求的独立验证集上选择插值权重，并与普通短查询分层比较；该方法需要额外前向计算，且英文离线收益尚不能直接代表中文搜索 CTR 收益。

papers.title: DUPAR: Dual-Path Conversational Retrieval via Speech Retriever with Cross-Turn Evidence Caching
papers.authors: Yuanjun Li, Yiwen Liu, Dapeng Li, Zhiwei Xu, Bin Zhang, Shengtao Zhang, Rong Shen
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.18042v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Voice assistants grounded in external knowledge typically use automatic speech recognition (ASR) to transcribe speech queries before retrieving evidence from textual knowledge bases. This cascade adds latency and propagates recognition errors, whereas direct speech retrieval is vulnerable to cross-modal misalignment. To address these limitations, we propose DUPAR, a conversational retrieval framework with complementary slow and fast paths. The fast path uses a task-adapted audio encoder aligned with frozen BGE-M3 text embeddings to search a cross-turn evidence cache. When cache confidence is insufficient, the slow path fuses full-index retrieval using audio and ASR-transcript embeddings, and the selected evidence refreshes the next-turn evidence cache through one-hop graph expansion. On a domain-specific knowledge base, our trained audio encoder approaches text-retrieval accuracy on clean speech with a 3.75$\times$ query-side speedup ove
papers.summary: DUPAR 面向语音会话检索，将音频编码器对齐到冻结的 BGE-M3 文本向量，快路径检索跨轮证据缓存，低置信度时回退到音频与转写文本的全库融合。其查询侧速度为 ASR 加文本编码方案的 3.75 倍，噪声测试平均 Recall@10 从 0.771 升至 0.875，合成说话风格下 Recall@1 提高 4.2 个百分点。
papers.key_insight: 对有语音入口的社区短文本搜索，可以复用已有文本索引，仅训练音频侧对齐模块以减少转写错误传播。跨轮缓存及一跳邻居扩展适合连续追问，但收益依赖前轮证据正确与后轮目标的邻接关系；上线实验需单独评估话题切换、缓存误命中和噪声分层，不能把查询侧加速当作端到端时延收益。

papers.title: PageRecall: Measuring Page Selection in Literature-Grounded Question Answering
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.18154v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We describe our system for LitTraceQA (GroundLM @ EMNLP 2026): given a research question, retrieve the relevant papers from a pool of 27,487, cite the page and the table or figure where the answer lives, and answer in a requested format. Our main finding is that evidence grounding is limited by retrieval, not by reading. The page selector put the annotator's page, which we call the gold page, in front of the model that locates evidence only about half the time (52.6% gold-page recall), while that model, given the page, cited the right one in 45 of the 48 locators it emitted (94%). When the page was missing it rarely said so: of 45 such cases it returned nothing 14 times, a wrong page 24 times, and a correct page 7 times, so the pipeline failed quietly almost twice as often as it failed visibly. Since the failure was that the right page was never shown, the fix is to stop choosing: each retrieved paper fits in the model's context, so we s
papers.summary: PageRecall 分析文献问答中的页面筛选瓶颈：在 27,487 篇论文池中，正确页面进入证据模型的比例仅 52.6%，而页面已给定时模型发出的 48 个定位中有 45 个正确。让整篇文档进入上下文后，开发集证据 F1 从 0.384 升至 0.456；论文因此强调先度量召回和筛选，再优化下游阅读。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的帖子、回答与评论链也会经历多级筛选，应分别统计候选召回、段落保留和最终排序，避免把上游漏召归因于大模型能力。短内容能装入上下文时可实验减少硬裁剪，同时保留成本与噪声对照；本文只有 55 个开发问题和 71 个测试问题，结论应作为诊断方法迁移，而非大规模线上收益保证。
